note: Issue #15 PR-15-B.  Evaluation-side metadata: whether a reviewed function-level
still holds under the premises a conditional proof depends on.  The checker never
reads this file and no outcome depends on it; only reporting/soundness_gate.py does.
A conditional result can contradict a reviewed relation only when EVERY premise of
its receipt is 'verified' here.  'unverified', 'not_applicable' and a missing entry
all mean the same thing to the gate: the contradiction is an investigation row, not
a soundness violation.  Raising an entry to 'verified' requires showing that the
witness difference recorded in the tsv survives the premise (for EXTERNAL_CALLEE_SPEC:
that the callee really behaves like the catalog specification on the witness input),
and writing that argument into 'evidence'.  No entry is verified today.
